utterances.speaker: Alex Rivera
utterances.text: Good morning everyone. Thanks for jumping on on time. We have a full house today for our Q4 Roadmap Planning session.

utterances.speaker: Priya Nair
utterances.text: Morning Alex. Really glad we have everyone here. Q4 is pivotal for our expansion goals, especially around self-serve conversion.

utterances.speaker: Daniel Okafor
utterances.text: Morning folks. Engineering is geared up. We've spent the last sprint reviewing the technical debt and architecture readiness.

utterances.speaker: Carlos Ramirez
utterances.text: Hey team. Sales pipeline for Q4 is looking massive, but we need clear packaging and timeline clarity to close the late-stage enterprise deals.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Weiss
utterances.text: Customer Success is here too. We have renewal data from Q3 that shows some urgent usability and onboarding friction we must solve.

utterances.speaker: Mei Lin
utterances.text: Design has completed the preliminary user journeys for self-serve setup. Excited to share the prototypes.

utterances.speaker: Tom Becker
utterances.text: Data team is present. I'll be sharing some metrics on event ingestion latency and warehouse query costs.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Khan
utterances.text: Marketing is ready. We have the SaaS Summit campaign locked and ready to deploy as soon as dates are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Alex Rivera
utterances.text: Perfect. Here is our agenda: first, a quick Q3 retro; second, Priority 1: Self-Serve Onboarding; third, the launch date decision; fourth, pricing and packaging; fifth, analytics and customer blockers; and finally, wrap-up and explicit action items.

utterances.speaker: Priya Nair
utterances.text: Let's stick to the time allocations so we have at least ten minutes for action items. Alex, kick us off with the retro.

utterances.speaker: Alex Rivera
utterances.text: Looking back at Q3: our revenue expansion reached 88% of target. Strong progress, but enterprise onboarding cycle time doubled from 14 days to 29 days.

utterances.speaker: Carlos Ramirez
utterances.text: The biggest slowdown was security approvals and custom calendar permission scopes. Enterprise IT teams repeatedly asked for SOC 2 Type II reports and granular role controls.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Weiss
utterances.text: And on the self-serve side, users who didn't receive a white-glove onboarding call had a 32% drop-off by day 14. They love the transcript, but many missed the AI summary templates.

utterances.speaker: Daniel Okafor
utterances.text: On engineering: we allocated 35% of engineering capacity to audio pipeline refactoring in Q3. The upside is that transcription turnaround dropped from 4 minutes down to 45 seconds.

utterances.speaker: Tom Becker
utterances.text: The turnaround drop was huge for user delight. However, our Snowflake query costs spiked 40% because of unindexed meeting segment lookups during search.

utterances.speaker: Daniel Okafor
utterances.text: We deployed the initial GIN indexes last week, which already cut query costs by 28%. We'll finalize that migration in Q4.

utterances.speaker: Priya Nair
utterances.text: So the takeaway is clear: enterprise needs compliance and permissions; self-serve needs an effortless, gamified first recording experience.

utterances.speaker: Priya Nair
utterances.text: Let's move to Priority 1: Self-serve onboarding. Our goal for Q4 is zero-touch time-to-value. A user should sign up and record their first call in under 2 minutes.

utterances.speaker: Mei Lin
utterances.text: We designed a lightweight three-step modal flow: first, Google or Zoom calendar connect; second, role selection; third, an automated 60-second simulated test call.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Weiss
utterances.text: Can we award points or a badge for completing that test call? Gamification showed a 2.4x increase in day-7 retention during our pilot.

utterances.speaker: Alex Rivera
utterances.text: Yes, 25 points on initial signup, plus 5 points for completing the simulated test call. That is already spec'd in the onboarding flow.

utterances.speaker: Daniel Okafor
utterances.text: From an engineering perspective, the simulated test call is very clean. We can bundle a 2-minute pre-recorded audio stream so users experience instant transcript sync without waiting on live bots.

utterances.speaker: Mei Lin
utterances.text: And the host permission dialog in the test call will mirror Zoom's native modal: 'Fathom Notetaker is requesting to record this meeting' with Approve and Decline buttons.

utterances.speaker: Priya Nair
utterances.text: I love that. It builds user muscle memory before they invite Fathom to a real client call.

utterances.speaker: Alex Rivera
utterances.text: Now to the launch date. Marketing proposed November 4th to align with the global SaaS Summit.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Khan
utterances.text: November 4th gives us massive PR leverage. We have two top-tier podcast sponsorships booked and a launch email to 150,000 subscribers ready to blast.

utterances.speaker: Daniel Okafor
utterances.text: I have to push back strongly against November 4th. Engineering cannot guarantee zero-downtime database migrations with only two weeks of staging tests under synthetic load.

utterances.speaker: Daniel Okafor
utterances.text: If we ship on November 4th and our audio processing queue backs up during the PR spike, it will destroy user trust.

utterances.speaker: Priya Nair
utterances.text: Daniel makes a compelling point. A botched launch with high latency is worse than delaying by two weeks.

utterances.speaker: Carlos Ramirez
utterances.text: Can we find a middle ground? What about mid-November?

utterances.speaker: Daniel Okafor
utterances.text: November 18th is realistic. It gives engineering a full two-week soak test on staging and allows us to stress test the Gemini fallback handlers.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Khan
utterances.text: If we move to November 18th, I will need to reach out to the podcast hosts today to reschedule the ad slots.

utterances.speaker: Alex Rivera
utterances.text: Let's make the final call right now: we launch on November 18th. Aisha, please reschedule the sponsorships and press embargo.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Khan
utterances.text: Understood. Rescheduling for the week of November 18th.

utterances.speaker: Alex Rivera
utterances.text: Next topic: Pricing and packaging restructure. Carlos, please walk through the proposal.

utterances.speaker: Carlos Ramirez
utterances.text: Thanks Alex. We're keeping the free tier generous: unlimited recording and AI summaries for individual users. For teams, we introduce the Pro tier at $19 per user per month.

utterances.speaker: Carlos Ramirez
utterances.text: Pro tier includes team call sharing, CRM sync to Salesforce and HubSpot, and account-level Ask Fathom across all meetings.

utterances.speaker: Priya Nair
utterances.text: Just to confirm for everyone on the call: Carlos owns the pricing decision and the discount approval matrix.

utterances.speaker: Alex Rivera
utterances.text: Confirmed. Carlos owns the pricing decision. Carlos, when will the tier matrix and discount guidelines be finalized?

utterances.speaker: Carlos Ramirez
utterances.text: I will have the finalized pricing sheet and discount matrix signed off by this Friday at 5 PM.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Weiss
utterances.text: What about existing beta teams? How are we handling their transition?

utterances.speaker: Carlos Ramirez
utterances.text: Beta teams will be grandfathered on Pro free for 90 days, followed by a 20% discount on annual commitments.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Weiss
utterances.text: Turning to customer escalations: Ramp Enterprise is ready to expand from 20 to 500 seats, but their legal counsel requires our final SOC 2 Type II audit report before signing.

utterances.speaker: Daniel Okafor
utterances.text: Our external SOC 2 audit concludes next week. The official SOC 2 Type II report will be delivered by October 15th.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Weiss
utterances.text: That works. I'll notify Ramp's VP of Procurement today.

utterances.speaker: Tom Becker
utterances.text: On analytics and data: our warehouse connector has a 15-minute sync delay. If users use Ask Fathom on home to search recent calls, the warehouse will miss today's meetings.

utterances.speaker: Tom Becker
utterances.text: We recommend querying our direct search index pipeline, which delivers sub-50ms query times and instant real-time accuracy.

utterances.speaker: Daniel Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed. The direct index pipeline paired with the large neural context window eliminates the need for any secondary syncing lag.

utterances.speaker: Carlos Ramirez
utterances.text: Before we review action items—are we still confirmed for the team offsite in Lake Tahoe next month?

utterances.speaker: Priya Nair
utterances.text: Haha, yes Carlos! Lake Tahoe is booked for October 24th to 26th. Cabins and team dinners are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Alex Rivera
utterances.text: Awesome. Let's do a strict recap of action items and commitments:

utterances.speaker: Alex Rivera
utterances.text: Item 1: Carlos Ramirez to finalize the pricing sheet and discount approval matrix by Friday at 5 PM.

utterances.speaker: Alex Rivera
utterances.text: Item 2: Aisha Khan to reschedule the podcast sponsorships and press embargo for the November 18th launch.

utterances.speaker: Alex Rivera
utterances.text: Item 3: Daniel Okafor to deliver the final SOC 2 Type II compliance report to Hannah for Ramp Enterprise by October 15th.

utterances.speaker: Alex Rivera
utterances.text: Item 4: Mei Lin to finalize the self-serve onboarding Figma prototypes by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Alex Rivera
utterances.text: Item 5: Tom Becker to complete the search indexing performance upgrade by tomorrow afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Alex Rivera
utterances.text: Item 6: Hannah Weiss to update Ramp Enterprise procurement on the October 15th SOC 2 timeline.

utterances.speaker: Priya Nair
utterances.text: I will compile this meeting's summary in Fathom and share the link with the executive team. Great meeting everyone!

utterances.speaker: Daniel Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks all, see you at standup.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Weiss
utterances.text: Thanks team!

utterances.speaker: Carlos Ramirez
utterances.text: Catch you later!
